_comment: MLV-App's values for the fleet doctrine outbox. Data only: tools/coordination/doctrine_outbox.py is the config-driven shared file offered as the candidate for the bus's tools/factory/doctrine_outbox.py (adoption is pending the bus steward, see the handoff card in doctrine-outbox/). Once the bus holds it, each project pins a reviewed bus SHA in factory-pins/factory-pins.json and runs it through factory-pins/pin-runner.py with --config, and keeps its local copy until the pin-aware release OUTBOX-PIN-AWARE-TOOL-AT-REF-1 (the installed hook and the debt checks still read tool_rel). It is never edited here for a project value. The tool finds this file at the repo root (or via --config / $DOCTRINE_OUTBOX_CONFIG).
